answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 10908 Country: India Title: In our syster home, they put the name of my sister daughter is "CHANDINI" for Elder Child and "NAZINI" for Younger Child. Is this name is correct according to Islam and what its actual meanings. Or we need to add something before her name. Plz suggest. Question: In our syster home, they put the name of my sister daughter is "CHANDINI" for Elder Child and "NAZINI" for Younger Child. Is this name is correct according to Islam and what its actual meanings. Or we need to add something before her name. Plz suggest. Answer ID: 10908 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 243/243=M/1430) Chandni means: moonlight, white sheet, a kind of flower Naznin means: beautiful, fascinating, charming Both the names are correct. It is permissible to have some prefix name as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
